summary: Verified react-router missing-dependency compile bug is RESOLVED. Frontend loads without CRA/webpack error overlay, login succeeds with owner creds, client-side navigation works, and both previously-failing routes (/admin/abc-supply using useSearchParams, /admin/settings using Link) render cleanly with zero console/page errors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: react-router@7.15.0 is present in /app/frontend/node_modules/react-router. Frontend compiles with warnings only. Verified: (1) landing page loads to /login with no compile error overlay, (2) owner login successful redirecting to dashboard, (3) client-side nav via internal <Link> anchors works (/ -> /leads), (4) /admin/abc-supply (useSearchParams) and /admin/settings (Link) render without runtime errors, (5) 0 console errors, 0 page errors captured during full flow.
rca of the issue: Original: react-router (transitive dep of react-router-dom@7.15.0) was missing from node_modules causing 103 webpack errors on exports like useSearchParams and Link. Fix applied by main agent (yarn install --ignore-engines + supervisor restart) restored the package. Verified fix by loading app, logging in, navigating between routes, and hitting the specific pages that imported the broken exports.
